ValidationRule.description: Prevents Apollo Assistant AI, Credit PreQual, and VDV from being sold on an Opportunity if the related Account has a Recent Start Date for the same product within the last 2 months.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( Apollo_Assistant__c = "Sold", NOT(ISBLANK( Account.Apollo_Assistant_AI_First_Billing_Date__c )), Account.Apollo_Assistant_AI_First_Billing_Date__c >= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -2) ), AND( Credit_PreQual__c = "Sold Prequal", NOT(ISBLANK(Account.Credit_Prequal_First_Billing_Date__c)), Account.Credit_Prequal_First_Billing_Date__c>= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -2) ), AND( VDV__c = "Sold VDV", NOT(ISBLANK( Account.VDV_Plus_First_Billing_Date__c )), Account.VDV_Plus_First_Billing_Date__c >= ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -2) ) ) && $Profile.Name != "System Administrator" && Bypass_Closing_Rules__c =false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This product was active within the last 2 months on the related Account. Please review the Account Recent Start Date before marking it sold again.
